character.name: Аня
character.features: oval face, soft jawline, warm light skin, hazel-brown eyes with an amber ring, thin arched eyebrows, small straight nose, natural rose lips, almost no makeup
character.hair: dark chestnut-brown, shoulder length, soft side-swept fringe across the forehead, a few loose strands
character.style: flat anime / webtoon, clean thin line art, gentle cel shading, muted warm palette, soft light from the upper left

base_prompt: Flat anime / webtoon illustration, head-and-shoulders portrait of a 33-year-old woman. Oval face with a soft jawline, warm light skin, hazel-brown eyes with a subtle amber ring, thin naturally arched eyebrows, small straight nose, natural rose lips, almost no makeup. Dark chestnut-brown hair, shoulder length, soft side-swept fringe across the forehead, a few loose strands framing the face. She wears a cream oversized knit sweater. Plain warm greige background (#EFE7E3). Soft diffused light from the upper left, gentle cel shading, clean thin line art, muted warm palette, no harsh highlights. Expression: calm and attentive — relaxed eyebrows, eyes open at a normal width, lips closed in a neutral line, gaze directly at the viewer. Centered composition at eye level, 1:1 square framing, high detail on the face. No text, no watermark, no logo.
edit_template: Using the attached portrait as the reference, change ONLY her facial expression to: {emotion}. Keep her identity exactly the same: same face shape, same eye color and eye shape, same eyebrows, same nose and lips, same hairstyle and fringe direction, same cream sweater, same head angle, same lighting, same warm greige background, same art style and line weight. Do not beautify, do not change her age, do not change makeup, do not change the pose. Square 1:1. No text, no watermark.

emotions.label: Спокойно
emotions.prompt: a calm, attentive expression: eyebrows relaxed at their natural height, eyelids open at a normal width, mouth closed with a barely visible soft smile, gaze directly at the viewer.

emotions.label: Устала
emotions.prompt: tired and drained: upper eyelids lowered about halfway, gaze slightly unfocused, eyebrows flat with the inner ends a little raised, mouth slightly open as if exhaling, head tilted a few degrees to one side, faint shadows under the eyes.

emotions.label: Раздражена
emotions.prompt: irritated and tense: eyebrows pulled down and together, eyes narrowed, pupils slightly smaller, lips pressed into a thin line, jaw tight, faint flush on the cheeks.

emotions.label: Обижена
emotions.prompt: hurt and offended: inner ends of the eyebrows raised, eyes wide and glistening with unshed tears, mouth small and downturned, chin slightly lowered, gaze at the viewer.

emotions.label: Закрылась
emotions.when: открытость упала, она уходит в себя
emotions.prompt: closed off and guarded: eyes looking away to the side, eyelids lowered, lips a flat line, head turned slightly away from the viewer, shoulders a little hunched.

emotions.label: Теплеет
emotions.prompt: softening: eyebrows relaxed, eyelids slightly lowered in a gentle look, faint warm smile with lips together, soft blush on the cheeks, gaze at the viewer.

emotions.label: Улыбается
emotions.prompt: a genuine warm smile: eyes curved with happiness, cheeks raised, lips parted in a natural smile showing a hint of teeth, eyebrows relaxed.

emotions.label: Слёзы
emotions.prompt: crying quietly: eyes wet and shining, one tear running down her cheek, inner eyebrows raised, lips trembling slightly and slightly parted, chin lowered, restrained — no sobbing, no exaggerated drama.
